title: Would not buy again nor recommend.
text:
Would not buy again nor recommend.. Frustrating! have to push buttons multiple times in order for it to reset and work properly. Would not buy again nor recommend.

**UPDATE** I had given it two stars originally but now downgraded to one star because the timer just stopped working! Changed batteries, talked to it, brought it flowers, nothing worked!. Waste of money.
